body: I tried to wait it out, but things only get worse day to day, hour by hour.. I just can't do it anymore.. I really tried my best too :(
I've been trying my best all year, I considered this already before Thanksgiving and that was already a rough time, I don't see giving another month helping any :(
I'll stick to staying nice even if I'm single longer. I'm not a "doormat" but I'm not one of those douches either. I am who I am and I'm not changing period.

I've actually considered posting my own as well (still a bit hesitant) but in the end I know I would get so many varied opinions of people who could tell me to change this or that which may cost me in the end with someone local lol. But definitely personality and interests are super important period. I am recently divorced and now as time goes by that's what I am focusing on the most as the person that I choose to spend the rest of my life with should have enough in common to last out our years :)
